hypothesis: Replacing asynchronous balanced-mixed exposure with explicit sequential stage advancement and equal per-family quotas will make the weak spatial-pair level measurable and reduce family-exposure variance, while the exact Flash12 policy remains the matched starting baseline.

matched_baseline.decision: retain Flash12; test one curriculum change before another scaled run

curriculum.sampling: sequential stage manifests with explicit cycle pass/stop/advance receipts; six task groups per sampling cycle, one prompt per family, four rollouts per prompt, 24 trace capacity; actual scored exposure is measured after admission, optimizer updates are recorded independently, and only the 4/4/8/4 optimizer targets advance stages; standard cyclic mixed sampling is not a curriculum

runtime_binding.optimizer_update_confirmation: TrainBatch selection is journaled first; only WeightWatcher.on_update for the expected policy version records the optimizer update
runtime_binding.dispatch_gate: binding-owned six-group gate is layered with Prime lead permission; active groups drain while fresh dispatch is paused
runtime_binding.trainer_candidate_inventory: controller inventory contains only exact trace IDs present in native TrainSink.pending_batch after process_group
runtime_binding.batch_boundary: _maybe_batch remains closed during group assembly and is released only after the active six-group pass receipt; in-group calls cannot ship carry-over traces
runtime_binding.resume_scope: only clean optimizer/stage boundaries or a persisted exact selected-batch/update/tail-purge reconciliation may resume; partial native buffers fail closed

supervision.reason: The completed same-run four-step code/canvas SFT panel was 32/32 valid both before and after; no new warmup is claimed.

pending_choices.batch_size: Prime batch_size=24 counts trainable traces; six per-family groups provide 24 cycle capacity, partial groups can span cycles, and the node-free Prime compatibility check is required before allocation
pending_choices.prime_tail_purge_hook: required before any stage transition; the runtime must physically consume and purge the exact recorded stage-tail trace IDs, so this preparation is not launch-ready
pending_choices.runtime_censored_cycle_purge: required: purge every native pending trace attributable to a censored six-group cycle before reopening the deterministic retry gate
pending_choices.runtime_resume_reconciliation: required: reconcile only a persisted exact selected TrainBatch against native startup policy.version/progress.step; partial cycle, dispatch cursor, or orphaned inventory states fail closed because native buffers are not durable
pending_choices.renderer_canary: measure the repaired renderer tail before any scaled rental
pending_choices.quality_threshold: schedule completion is a progression receipt, not a quality gate or claim of visual improvement; judge outcomes remain descriptive until the matched panel is complete
pending_choices.runtime_batch_boundary: required: defer Prime _maybe_batch until the active six-group cycle has a pass receipt; carried traces may fill the next optimizer batch only after that cycle completes
pending_choices.runtime_sampling_attempt_cap: required: every completed six-group attempt, including censored retries, increments persisted per-stage attempts and stops at the finite two-times cap
pending_choices.runtime_stale_group_cancellation: required: stale GroupCancellation voids every arrived group member as pipeline evidence and must leave no native pending IDs; non-stale cancellation may admit three scored traces with explicit placeholders
pending_choices.preflight_surface: hash-bound bootstrap, materializer, config/node preparation, HF snapshot-cache validation, explicit verified non-private renderer/browser scratch root, import-hook/real-renderer canary, foreground launch, receipt-derived launch_prepared.py handoff, run-owned adapter, runtime binding, sitecustomize, tail purge, and reviewed external photo runner/trainer wrappers; bootstrap/canary/launch/launch_prepared are prepared but not run
